description: The struggle to define what conservation means and determining who and what a conservationist is. Learn about the origins of a small local airline and how air travel impacts the lives of rural and urban communities.

title: The Joy of Crafting
description: Joy demonstrates the fun of Squeegee Painting. Malia Lagaso has a fun Shrink Art project. Joy introduces the newest alcohol markers called OLO Markers and colors an image for a card front.

title: Fashion Sense by Valerie
description: Go behind-the-scenes of an updated hairdo with Sara Rose of Salon Alaia and Dr. Yew from Aesthetics Hawaii sharing how to achieve a snatched jawline.

title: Showcase Hawaii
description: Celebrate Hawaii's beauty with the Hawaiian Scroll Adjustable Bracelets, featuring an elegant scroll design in gold or silver-plated brass. Adjustable sizes 7.5 to 9 for all, it's a timeless gift for any occasion.

title: The Champ Show
description: Join Champ as he visits local establishments and shows you the products and services they offer, including tasting the cuisine of Hawaii's eateries.

title: Painting in Paradise
description: Discover, learn and paint three species of amazing seahorses.

title: Cooking Hawaiian Style
description: Tavana, one of Hawai'i's most electrifying live performers, is a one-man band, mixing soulful rock, blues and island sounds; he runs Tavana's at Anna's; in the kitchen, he'll make panko-crusted ahi and watercress tofu salad.

title: Dut's Grindz & Goodtimes
description: Join Dut Leandro and his celebrity guests as they cook, fish, play music and always find good grinds.

title: Hawaii Skin Diver
description: Journey to Christmas Island for a Red Sea Ocean Adventure trip-of-a-lifetime to target the Giant Trevally.

title: Hawaiian Xtreme Sports TV
description: The 150th episode highlights some of the most beautiful and extreme moments ever captured on film.

title: OC Shorts
description: A mixed plate of the best in local programming.

title: Gameday Hawaii
description: Tune in for a fast-paced and informative preview of tonight's matchup, complete with standings, stats and players to watch.
